description: Answer 'am I signed in?' for the cloud tools: the cached MSAL accounts, and whether a browser or device-code sign-in is still pending, with its URL or code; optionally wait for it to complete. For the separate pac sign-in, cs_auth_who.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

wait.description: Block until the pending sign-in completes (up to 10 minutes)

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_login_status
title: Sign-in status
